fixed: A shared dance or program whose dances have a related-dance link now imports. Before, that dance was left out, a program slot showed "Dance not imported", and the message still said the import succeeded. A related link now comes along when its dance is in the same file or you already have it.
A dance with a video or web link imports when it comes back to a library that already has that link, such as a dance you shared and a friend sent back.
After importing a shared file, the message says how many dances could not be imported, if any.

ImportPipeline.commit gives every imported link a fresh id and adds related-dance links after the batch is written, resolving each target through the batch, json provenance, or a live local dance; an unresolved one is dropped with an archive_related_dance_unresolved issue on ImportSession.issues.
